title: Sribhumi NH-37 Protest: MLA Demands Urgent Restoration of 14-Km Stretch

ai.summary: Residents of Fakirabazar in Assam's Sribhumi district protested on NH-37 demanding urgent repairs due to deteriorating road conditions and waterlogging, with South Karimganj MLA Aminul Rashid Choudhury urging comprehensive restoration of the 14-km stretch.

facts.claim: Residents of Fakirabazar in Assam's Sribhumi district staged a protest on National Highway 37
facts.quote: Sribhumi: Residents of Fakirabazar in Assam's Sribhumi district staged a protest on National Highway 37 on Friday, demanding urgent repairs over deteriorating road conditions and severe waterlogging.

facts.claim: The affected road section covers approximately 14 kilometres
facts.quote: The affected road section covers approximately 14 kilometres, connecting Sribhumi town with the Sutarkandi border.

facts.claim: South Karimganj MLA Aminul Rashid Choudhury urged the district administration to ensure comprehensive restoration of the affected highway
facts.quote: South Karimganj MLA Aminul Rashid Choudhury joined the protest and urged the district administration to ensure comprehensive restoration of the affected highway.

facts.claim: The highway's condition was unacceptable given the traffic it carries
facts.quote: Choudhury stated that "the highway's condition was unacceptable given the traffic it carries."

facts.claim: Temporary repairs would not solve the problem
facts.quote: Choudhury also warned that "temporary repairs would not solve the problem," calling instead for a comprehensive restoration plan addressing the road's deteriorating condition.

ai.background_note: Residents of Fakirabazar in Assam's Sribhumi district are protesting deteriorating road conditions on NH-37, which connects Sribhumi town with the Sutarkandi border, demanding urgent repairs and comprehensive restoration of the 14-km stretch.
